GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 120 (21 Jan 46) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 634)
APO 500
21 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Disposition of Defense Contribution Fund
1. Reference is made to the memorandum of the Central Liaison Office dated 5 January 1946 (C.L.O. No. 43 (2.1)), subject: "Endowments from the National Defense Contributions and Other Similar Contributions to Create an Institution for Scientific Research." That memorandum referred to a special fund composed of voluntary contributions for war equipment, research, and servicemen's welfare, with an unexpended balance of ¥856,763,695 on 31 December 1945, and requested approval from this headquarters for the use of ¥500,000,000 of that balance to endow a Foundation for Scientific Research.
2. The proposed endowment is not approved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
